beats.say: Sixteen-year-old Max Dowman just took Jude Bellingham's record.
Case file two. A one-nil defeat against Portugal, and he's England under-twenty-ones' youngest ever player. Bellingham was seventeen.

card.label: England U21s' *youngest* ever
card.sub: 16 yrs, 10 months, 13 days · Bellingham: 17 yrs, 2 months, 6 days (v Kosovo, 2020) · came on in a 1-0 defeat against Portugal

beats.say: Not his first record. August twenty twenty-five, against Leeds: second-youngest player in Premier League history.
Then Slavia Prague, off the bench: youngest player ever in the Champions League. At fifteen. Moukoko's record? Gone too.

card.sub: 15 yrs, 308 days · beat Moukoko (16 yrs, 18 days)

beats.say: And that's not even the wild part. Against Everton: an assist, then a solo goal. Youngest scorer in Premier League history.

card.sub: youngest goalscorer in PL history · Arsenal's 2025/26 Goal of the Season

beats.say: At sixteen: the Premier League's youngest title winner. Four England age groups. France next.

card.label: U16 · U17 · U19 · *U21*
card.sub: youngest PL title winner · next: France, Ashton Gate, 16 Nov

beats.say: One record left: Ansu Fati's, youngest Champions League scorer. Arsenal say Max has until February twenty twenty-seven. Does he do it? Follow for the next Scout File.
